text:
carla: new thread for tonight's orbit-style rollout of feature.flag_orbit_enable. change window 00:30-03:30 UTC. plan: tiny canary 0.25% (10m) -> micro 2% (15m) -> small 12% (25m) -> 50% (20m) -> manual 100% with a safety leash at 50%. deploy-bot will apply weights.
ben: request: pin cohort 'internal-canaries' to orbit for full window so we can run the new prompt set A/B.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: schedule 2025-10-12T00:30:00Z. will snapshot telemetry at each step and post checkpoints. will pause on holdpoints or policy triggers.
carla: ops note: when we cross 12% -> 50% apply session-affinity pin for 90m to avoid mid-session model flips: /ops/pin-sessions route=ai-route version=v3 duration=90m
ops-jia: adding rollback criteria to the runbook: 1) 5xx > 0.9% sustained for 4m, 2) p95 latency +275ms over baseline for 3 consecutive windows, 3) semantic-regression alert fires on golden promptset (nonsense rate +10%). any trigger -> immediate flag disable + pin back to stable route + incident channel.
oncall-maya: i'll be oncall. if deploy-bot pauses for a holdpoint and i don't ack within 4m, auto-disable policy kicks in. ping @maya.
ben: quick ops snippets for emergency actions: ```bash
# disable flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \n  https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature.flag_orbit_enable/disable
# pin back to stable
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \n  https://ops.redwood/api/v1/pins -d '{"service":"ai-route","version":"v2.9"}'
# sanity check
curl https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature.flag_orbit_enable | jq .status
```
pm-eli: release notes blurb: "Orbit rollout of improved planning model (v3) for agent pipelines; gradual enablement with monitoring—broader launch after validation." keep customer-facing short.
ops-jia: regional capacity: will reserve 6% headroom in us-east and 4% in eu-west to prevent autoscaler thrash during the 12%->50% jump. pushing reserve configs now.
carla: small tweak: deploy-bot should annotate each checkpoint with rollout_id=20251012_orbit and include sample diffs (up to 20 examples) so we can eyeball regressions quickly.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. preflight smoke in staging passed at 23:40 UTC. readiness ok. will post checkpoint messages in this thread.
oncall-maya: acked. i'll watch dashboards and eval alerts. if no issues at 12% for 30m (two windows) we can consider accelerating the 50% step with my manual go-ahead.
ben: noted. tagging runbook: /runbooks/releases/2025-10-12-orbit-rollout.txt
carla: thanks team. will start the rollout as scheduled and post the final ramp summary here after the window. :rocket:
